source_edition: arXiv1310.2940v2, 6December2013; journal/preprint differences not independently checked
stage: Source-audited reconstruction specification; no Kim2013 background, eigenvalue or eigenfunction computed yet.
priority: User explicitly requires detailed analytical reproduction, especially eigenfunctions. Figure9 is the primary acceptance target; Figure5 growth rates alone are insufficient.

reviewed.text: Sections2–3, Figure9 discussion and AppendixA read.

model.density_convention: n=rho/m and P=n kB T, following the source
model.geometry: Steady plane-parallel front; CNM left, WNM right
model.approximation: Source isobaric/low-Mach reduction. Retain hydrodynamic perturbation coupling; do not claim an exact full-compressible spectrum.

primary_target.comparison: One common amplitude/phase and front-origin convention. No separate fitting or normalization of the two plotted fields. Distinguish analytic solid curves from simulation dots.

linear_problem.warning: A6 lists J,M,V,Theta, while the A15–A19 state-vector order is J,V,M,Theta,dTheta/dxi.
linear_problem.physical_transverse_velocity: Re[-i V exp(Omega t+i k y)] times v_x1; -i must be retained
linear_problem.temperature_plot_conversion: Theta times T1/T_background, not Theta alone
linear_problem.boundary_rule: Re(beta)>0 upstream; Re(beta)<0 downstream. Source beta_t-minus names the positive root on the upstream side, not the minus arithmetic sign in A14.
linear_problem.normalization: C1=1 in A20–A21, or a documented equivalent common gauge; preserve all intercomponent amplitudes and phases.
linear_problem.matching: Five-component continuity at a common point, with scaled residuals and no division by vanishing components.

supporting_targets.dispersion: Figure5: vertical axis Omega ell_D1/v_x1 = nu*sigma, not sigma; horizontal axis nu.
supporting_targets.cutoff: Source nu_crit about0.52–0.54; approach from the unstable branch and enlarge the domain as vortex decay becomes long.

acceptance: Background BVP/mass-flux/energy-integral convergence before stability integration.
Verify all far-field basis vectors against the constant-coefficient equations.
Equation, boundary and matching residuals for every eigenfunction component.
Domain, grid, interpolation and tolerance refinement preserve eigenvalues AND normalized eigenfunction shapes.
Recover k=0 translation mode and long-wave displacement asymptotics without imposing them at finite k.
Track a continuous eigenmode branch by overlap when sweeping k.
Source digitization with calibration and uncertainty; compare signs, extrema, nodes, relative amplitudes and tails.
Independent discretization or small-amplitude linear evolution for a representative mode before detailed-reproduction status.
Export raw state and reconstructed physical components with units, common gauge, masks and approximation order.
open_questions: In inspected v2 p5, the1800 evaporation example text gives Lf=0.13pc, while Table1 gives0.29pc. Check journal version/definitions; do not tune coordinates to fit either number.

Figure9 absolute amplitude at t/tgr=2 depends on projection of the initially shifted front onto the growing mode and transient evolution. A shared arbitrary eigenfunction normalization establishes shapes and relative amplitudes, not that absolute initial-value comparison.
limits: No source-curve digitization, solver, eigenfunction data or 2D reproduction yet.
A full nonlinear2D rerun is a separate optional scope; detailed one-dimensional/Fourier-mode linear analysis is required.
